closed_findings.title: Wide glyph at the last inner column can overwrite the pane border
closed_findings.evidence: A shared wcswidth guard excludes any glyph whose full display width exceeds the pane inner boundary in normal curses and RGB paths; RGB run end tracking uses display width. The 30-to-28 resize fixture rejects four clipped wide/combining subcases while preserving fitting wide, continuation-skip, combining, SGR grouping, and cursor restore behavior.
